entities.name: SMS services status information element
entities.description: Indicates the status of SMS services with values representing availability, network failure, or congestion conditions.

entities.name: Additional update result information element
entities.description: Provides additional update result information including CS Fallback preference and SMS-only indications.

entities.name: Service type information element
entities.description: Defines service types for mobile originating/terminating CS fallback, emergency calls, and packet services via S1.

entities.name: Additional update type information element
entities.description: Contains additional update type values, signalling active flag, and preferred CIoT network behaviour indicators.

entities.name: Extended Emergency Number List Validity information IE
entities.description: Specifies the validity scope of extended local emergency numbers list (country-wide or PLMN-specific).

entities.name: Paging identity information element
entities.description: Indicates the paging identity type used, either IMSI or TMSI.

entities.name: SMS services status conditions
entities.description: Defines the conditions for SMS services status including availability, network failure, and congestion.

entities.name: CIoT network behaviour conditions
entities.description: Specifies preferred CIoT network behaviour options including control plane and user plane optimizations.

entities.name: Emergency number validity conditions
entities.description: Determines whether extended emergency numbers list is valid country-wide or PLMN-specific.

entities.name: Paging identity type conditions
entities.description: Specifies whether paging identity is IMSI or TMSI based on bit value.

relations.description: SMS services status IE is defined by specific condition values for service availability.
Additional update type IE includes conditions for preferred CIoT network behaviour.
Extended emergency number list validity IE is determined by validity scope conditions.
Paging identity IE is defined by conditions specifying IMSI or TMSI usage.
